findings.description: The profile's description holds the rule 'Not for codebase-internal exploration - use the Explore subagent for that'. Its first half is kept (agent description 'Not for exploring this repository's own code', skill introduction 'search the repository, not this skill'), but no row lists it and the pointer to the Explore subagent is dropped without a reason. Remediation: add a row for it, with the agent description and the skill introduction as destinations and the reason the Explore pointer is dropped (a harness-specific agent name) or keep the pointer.

'Delete the clones you made once you have reported' cannot be followed by the agent: its report is its final message (or SubagentHandback), which ends the run, so the clones are never deleted. Remediation: delete the clones after writing the reply file and before the final report, unless the caller asked to keep them (and say in the report which clones were kept and where).

Boundaries says 'Do not change any file of the workspace ... The one exception is the reply file', while step 3 allows cloning into the git-ignored .tmp/ of the workspace. The contradiction was inherited from the profile. Remediation: name the clone directory (.tmp/ or /tmp/tracker-research/) as a second exception, or say 'Do not change any tracked file of the workspace'.

WebFetch and WebSearch are the tools the workflow needs most, and in this Claude Code build they are deferred tools (loaded through ToolSearch, which the agent does not list). Section V1 of manual-verification-evidence.md showed that a listed tool the build does not offer is dropped silently. Nothing on the branch shows the researcher actually receives them. Remediation: when M1 is rerun for the full roster (AC1, T9 or T10), check the tools the researcher's transcript lists; if WebFetch or WebSearch is missing, add ToolSearch or record the limitation. A short probe now would close it earlier.

related-artifacts lists .claude/skills/create-issue/SKILL.md, but neither file links or names the other. Remediation: either say in the introduction that research usually precedes create-issue and link it, or drop the entry.
The new table's columns are not padded like every other table of the index (the linter accepts it). Remediation: align it as the other sections are.

The repository has docs/research/ (timestamped research documents, input to design decisions) and docs/external-snapshots/ (immutable copies of sources). The skill does not say where research goes when the caller wants it kept. The profile did not say either, so this is optional: one sentence linking docs/research/AGENTS.md would connect the two.
